title: AIでBlenderを操作する方法 - CLIとMCPの使い分け｜npaka
h2: 4. Blender CLI と Blender MCPの違い
6. CLI と MCP を組み合わせる
7. どちらを使えばよいか
split: CLI generates Blender Python and runs from the command line (example blender scene.blend --background --python script.py). MCP attaches to a running Blender and inspects state interactively. CLI = batch/auto; MCP = dialogue. Combine: CLI base scene, MCP tweak, CLI batch export. Names Codex and Claude Code.
